This assignment is in place of class on Monday, September 21, 2026.

Run this code and then practice creating new code chunks with additional graphs. First make changes to the `dbwt` graph, and then create graphs using other columns in the dataset.

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)

df <- read_csv("nat2024samp5702.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Quick look
glimpse(df |> select(dbwt, mager, sex, bmi, combgest, wtgain))
```

## 1. Original birthweight histogram

`dbwt` = birth weight in grams. Values of `9999` are missing codes, so we filter them out.

```{r}
#| label: birthweight
df_bw <- df |> filter(dbwt < 9999)

ggplot(df_bw, aes(x = dbwt)) + 
  geom_histogram(fill = "cornflowerblue",
                 color = "blue",
                 boundary = 0,
                 binwidth = 250) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 2. Changed `dbwt` graph

Practice: change color, binwidth, add labels, and facet by baby sex.

```{r}
#| label: birthweight-improved
ggplot(df_bw, aes(x = dbwt)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "darkorange",
                 color = "white",
                 boundary = 0,
                 binwidth = 200) +
  facet_wrap(~ sex) +
  labs(
    title = "Birth weight by sex",
    x = "Birth weight (grams)",
    y = "Number of births"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 3. More graphs with other columns

### Mother's age

```{r}
#| label: mother-age
ggplot(df, aes(x = mager)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Mother's age at birth",
    x = "Age (years)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Birth weight vs gestational age

```{r}
#| label: weight-vs-gestation
df_plot <- df |>
  filter(dbwt < 9999, combgest < 99)

ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = combgest, y = dbwt)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15, color = "purple") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Birth weight vs gestational age",
    x = "Gestational age (weeks)",
    y = "Birth weight (grams)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### BMI of mother (boxplot by sex of baby)

```{r}
#| label: bmi-by-sex
df_bmi <- df |>
  filter(bmi < 99)

ggplot(df_bmi, aes(x = sex, y = bmi, fill = sex)) +
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Mother's BMI by infant sex",
    x = "Infant sex",
    y = "BMI"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Births by month

```{r}
#| label: births-by-month
ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(dob_mm))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "seagreen") +
  labs(
    title = "Births by month (2024 sample)",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
